ratings.heading: Average of 3 booking sites, weighted by number of reviews

tested.pop_html: I visited Széchenyi myself. Most of the photos on this card are my own.What I checked: pools, changing rooms, crowds and value for money. Full review ↓

pills.label: Daily · 7:00–20:00
pills.pop_html: Mon–Thu 7:00–20:00 · Fri 7:00–22:00 · Sat–Sun 8:00–20:00. 8 December 2026: closes at 16:00. 18 December 2026 to 6 January 2027: opens at 8:00. 25 and 26 December and 1 January: opens at 10:00.Hours change by season and on holidays.

pills.label: 3 outdoor + 15 indoor pools
pills.pop_html: Outdoor: swimming pool 26–28 °C, thermal pool 36–38 °C, adventure pool 32–34 °C. Indoor: medicinal pools 28–40 °C and plunge pools at 18 °C and 40 °C.Temperatures from szechenyifurdo.hu; the pool count is from the ticket listings.

pills.label: Locker or cabin
pills.pop_html: GetYourGuide (Thu 19 Nov 2026): Morning Pass with locker, entry 7:00–9:00, €39 · Weekday Pass with locker €46 · Weekday Pass with private cabin €50. At the desk (2026): locker ticket 13,200 HUF Mon–Thu, 14,800 HUF Fri–Sun, 15,800 HUF in peak periods; cabin +1,000 HUF.Desk prices from szechenyifurdo.hu/arak-2026.

pills.label: Sparty on Saturdays
pills.pop_html: Sparty is the Saturday night pool party at Széchenyi: from €73 on GetYourGuide (start 21:30), or €100 with two drink coupons. 18+ only and non-refundable. See Sparty tickets →Prices for Saturday 21 November 2026.

best_for.pick_html: for the classic Budapest bath: big outdoor pools in a yellow neo-baroque palace, open until 22:00 on Fridays.
best_for.skip_html: if you want quiet: it gets busy from late morning, so come at 7:00 on a weekday or pick Lukács or Veli Bej.

items.a: Yes, for a first visit. It is the biggest and most photogenic bath in Budapest. Go early on a weekday to avoid the crowds.
Between 7:00 and 10:00 on a weekday. By late morning the outdoor pools are packed.
A standard ticket includes a locker in the gender-separated changing area, opened with a plastic wristwatch (3,000 HUF if lost). A private cabin costs 1,000 HUF extra.
No. Bring a swimsuit, towel and flip-flops; the desk sells a towel for 6,900 HUF, slippers for 4,200 HUF and a swim cap for 2,100 HUF.
It is open until 22:00 on Fridays. Sparty, the Saturday night pool party, is sold separately: 18+, from €73, non-refundable.

price.note: Online price for Thu 19 Nov 2026; desk prices from the bath's 2026 price list. All Széchenyi tickets →

tested.pop_html: I visited Rudas myself.What I checked: pools, changing rooms, crowds and value for money. Full review ↓

pills.label: Daily · 6:00–20:00
pills.pop_html: Wellness: Mon 6:00–22:00, Tue–Sun 6:00–20:00. Night bathing: Fri and Sat 22:00–3:00 (15,000 HUF, online tickets only). 8 December 2026: closes at 16:00.Hours change by season and on holidays.

pills.label: Men / women days
pills.pop_html: Turkish bath, men only: Mon, Thu and Fri 6:00–10:45, Wed 6:00–20:00. Women only: Tue 6:00–20:00. Mixed: Mon 11:00–22:00, Thu and Fri 11:00–20:00, Sat and Sun 6:00–20:00.From the official timetable on rudasfurdo.hu.

pills.label: Rooftop pool 36 °C
pills.pop_html: Panorama pool on the roof at 36 °C. Turkish bath: six pools at 16, 28, 30, 33, 36 and 42 °C. Wellness: pools at 11, 32, 36 and 42 °C. Swimming pool: 29 °C.From rudasfurdo.hu.

pills.label: What the ticket includes
pills.pop_html: The GetYourGuide ticket is a day pass plus a 3-course meal at Rudas Bistro: wellness + coffee €74.99, wellness + wine €76.99, Turkish bath + wellness + coffee €84.99. At the desk: all zones 12,000 HUF Mon–Thu, 15,000 HUF Fri–Sun, without a meal.Prices for Thursday 19 November 2026.

pills.label: 14+ · not step-free
pills.pop_html: Children under 14 are not admitted. The bath currently cannot receive guests with reduced mobility for technical reasons.From rudasfurdo.hu.

best_for.pick_html: for an Ottoman-era Turkish bath under a stone dome plus a rooftop hot pool with a Danube view, and for night bathing on weekends.
best_for.skip_html: if you travel with kids under 14, need step-free access, or only want a bath ticket without the meal.

items.a: For atmosphere, often yes: the Ottoman Turkish bath and the rooftop pool are unique. For a family day out, no: Rudas admits no under-14s.

items.q: When are the men-only and women-only days?
items.a: Men: Mon, Thu and Fri 6:00–10:45 and all day Wednesday. Women: all day Tuesday. Weekends are mixed.
Yes, Friday and Saturday 22:00–3:00. Night tickets are sold online only: 15,000 HUF (18,000 HUF on 1 and 2 January 2027). Night buses 907 and 973 run afterwards.
A day pass plus a 3-course meal at Rudas Bistro, from €74.99. A plain entry ticket is only sold at the desk.
No. There are no children under 14, and currently no access for guests with reduced mobility.

price.note: Online price for Thu 19 Nov 2026; desk prices from the bath's 2026 price list.

pills.label: Daily · 7:00–19:00
pills.pop_html: Mon, Wed–Sun 7:00–19:00 · Tue 7:00–22:00. The online ticket has a 9:00–17:00 window for Thu 19 Nov.Hours change by season and on holidays.

pills.label: Medicinal pools 32–40 °C
pills.pop_html: Indoor medicinal pools at 32, 36 and 40 °C, a 20 °C cold pool and a 20 °C Kneipp foot path. Outdoor: adventure pool 33–35 °C and swimming pools at 22 and 26 °C.From lukacsfurdo.hu.

pills.label: Cabin or locker
pills.pop_html: The GetYourGuide ticket is a full-day entry with a cabin or locker, depending on availability: €33. At the desk (2026): 7,000 HUF Mon–Thu, 8,000 HUF Fri–Sun; sauna world +1,300 HUF.Prices for Thursday 19 November 2026.

pills.label: 14+ · partial closures
pills.pop_html: Children under 14 are not admitted. The wheelchair lifts are out of order for technical reasons, and the private tub service is closed for renovation.From lukacsfurdo.hu.

best_for.pick_html: for a smaller bath with strong medicinal pools, open until 22:00 on Tuesdays.
best_for.skip_html: if you want grand architecture or a party feel, or if you travel with kids under 14.

items.q: Is Lukács a good alternative to Széchenyi?
items.a: Yes, if you want thermal water without the crowds. It is smaller and plainer, closer to a local bath than a tourist sight.
Indoor medicinal pools at 32, 36 and 40 °C, a 20 °C cold pool, an outdoor adventure pool at 33–35 °C and swimming pools at 22 and 26 °C.
Until 22:00 every Tuesday. The other days it is open 7:00–19:00.
Not right now: the wheelchair lifts are out of order and the private tubs are closed for renovation.
Frankel Leó út 25-29: tram 4, 6, 17 or 19, bus 9 or 109, or the HÉV to Margit híd, budai hídfő. Veli Bej is on the same street, so do not mix them up.

tested.pop_html: I visited Palatinus myself in summer.What I checked: pools, changing rooms, crowds and value for money. Full review ↓

pills.label: Winter · 9:00–16:00
pills.pop_html: Daily 9:00–16:00 since 19 October 2026 (winter season).Hours change by season and on holidays.

pills.label: 11 outdoor + 4 indoor pools
pills.pop_html: Outdoor: wave pool 28 °C, swimming pool 26 °C, slide pool 26–28 °C, thermal pools 30–32 and 33–36 °C, adventure, beach, kids' and learner pools 30–36 °C. Indoor: medicinal pool 36 °C, kids' pool 32–34 °C, plunge pools 20–22 and 40–42 °C.From palatinusstrand.hu; not every outdoor pool runs in winter.

pills.label: Family tickets
pills.pop_html: At the desk (2026): adult 3,800 HUF weekdays / 4,200 HUF weekends; child (3–14) 2,500 / 2,800 HUF; family ticket for 3 (at least 1 child) 7,600 / 8,400 HUF; for 4 (at least 2 children) 10,100 / 11,200 HUF.From palatinusstrand.hu/arak-2026.

pills.label: Winter limits
pills.pop_html: The Finnish sauna is out of service from 14 November 2026, and a broken lift at the main entrance means wheelchair users cannot be received for now.From palatinusstrand.hu.

best_for.pick_html: for a summer day with kids: a wave pool, slides and lawns on Margaret Island, with family tickets.
best_for.skip_html: if you visit in winter for a long soak: it closes at 16:00, and the slides and many outdoor pools are a summer thing.

items.q: Is Palatinus worth it in winter?
items.a: Only for a short visit. In winter it closes at 16:00, and the Finnish sauna is out of service from 14 Nov 2026.
A shallow outdoor kids' pool (30–32 °C), an indoor one (32–34 °C) and a 28 °C wave pool; the slides open in summer. Child tickets are for ages 3–14.
Yes: two thermal pools at 30–32 °C and 33–36 °C plus a 36 °C indoor medicinal pool.
Bus 26 from Nyugati pályaudvar or Árpád híd stops right outside. In summer the bath also runs its own minibus.
Adult tickets include a locker, but I found them small, so pack light. A cabin ticket costs 1,000 HUF.

price.note: Online price for Thu 19 Nov 2026; desk prices from the bath's 2026 price list.

tested.pop_html: I visited Dandár myself.What I checked: pools, changing rooms, crowds and value for money. Full review ↓

pills.label: Daily · 9:00–19:00
pills.pop_html: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun 9:00–19:00 · Thu 9:00–22:00.Hours change by season and on holidays.

pills.label: 4 thermal pools
pills.pop_html: Indoor: medicinal pools at 35 and 38 °C, a Finnish sauna and a cold plunge pool. Outdoor: pools at 36 and 38 °C with a lawn and sun loungers. The neck shower at the outdoor 38 °C pool is out of service for now.From dandarfurdo.hu.

pills.label: Cheapest desk price
pills.pop_html: At the desk (2026): thermal ticket 3,500 HUF weekdays / 4,000 HUF weekends; with sauna world and outdoor pools 4,500 / 5,000 HUF; cabin 800 HUF. The GetYourGuide ticket is €22 for a full day with a cabin or locker.Desk prices from dandarfurdo.hu/arak-2026; GetYourGuide price for Thu 19 Nov 2026.

pills.label: 14+ only
pills.pop_html: Only guests aged 14 and over are admitted.From dandarfurdo.hu.

best_for.pick_html: for the cheapest real thermal bath in Budapest, used mostly by locals, with outdoor hot pools.
best_for.skip_html: if you want grand architecture: Dandár is plain, and it is outside the tourist centre.

items.q: Is Dandár worth visiting as a tourist?
items.a: Yes, if you want a cheap, local bath and do not care about architecture. It is the opposite of Széchenyi.

items.q: How cheap is it at the desk?
items.a: 3,500 HUF on weekdays and 4,000 HUF at weekends; with the sauna and outdoor pools it is 4,500 / 5,000 HUF.
Two outdoor pools at 36 and 38 °C, with a lawn and sun loungers.
Thursdays until 22:00. The other days it is open 9:00–19:00.

items.q: What can I pair it with?
items.a: It is a stone's throw from the Zwack Unicum factory. Tram 2 or 24, or bus 23 or 54, take you there.

price.note: Online price for Thu 19 Nov 2026; desk prices from the bath's 2026 price list.

pills.pop_html: Mon–Tue 15:00–21:00 · Wed–Sun 6:00–12:00 and 15:00–21:00. Closed every day 12:00–15:00 to change the water. Cashier closes at 11:00 and 20:00. Closed on 23, 24 and 25 December 2026.Hours change by season and on holidays.

pills.label: Octagonal pool 36–38 °C
pills.pop_html: Turkish bath: five pools, the octagonal central pool at 36–38 °C and four smaller pools at different temperatures. Wellness: two steam baths, Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, jacuzzi, Kneipp path and a 15 m pool at 32 °C.From the official Veli Bej pages on irgalmasrend.hu.

pills.label: Desk only
pills.pop_html: No online tickets or booking: pay at the cashier. Morning 5,700 HUF (Wed–Fri); afternoon 6,700 HUF (Mon–Thu); Fri afternoon, Sat and Sun 7,200 HUF.From irgalmasrend.hu/hu/velibej/araink.

pills.label: 14+ only
pills.pop_html: Under-14s are not admitted, even with a parent; bring an ID that shows the date of birth.From irgalmasrend.hu.

best_for.pick_html: for a quiet, authentic Ottoman bath under the old domes, without the crowds of Rudas.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to book online or bathe at midday: it is desk-only and closed 12:00–15:00.

items.q: How is Veli Bej different from Rudas?
items.a: Both are Ottoman baths, but Veli Bej is smaller, quieter and cheaper, and you cannot book it online.
No. Tickets are sold only at the cashier, so just turn up.
Mon–Tue 15:00–21:00; Wed–Sun 6:00–12:00 and 15:00–21:00. It closes every day from 12:00 to 15:00.
Visitors consistently describe it as calm, with empty pools early in the morning.
No under-14s, even with a parent.
